The '''CM-5 Concussion Missile''' was a weapon used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]].<ref name="TT">[[Tyrant's Test]]</ref>

A single [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter|K-wing]] could carry eight CM-fives on its external pylons, along with an additional "egg" on the centreline hardpoint. Larger capital ships, however, carried the tube-launched [[CM-9]].
